after.title: Great Dane Urn for Dog Ashes, Unique Wooden Memorial, Personalised with Photo
after.description: A handmade wooden urn for your Great Dane, decorated with a ceramic plaque with a modern geometric portrait of the breed and a plaque with a quote. Keep it at home in a quiet place, a lasting tribute ...
